name: ea-sports-ufc-6-pride-fc-expansion
lines:
كانت PRIDE من أشهر بطولات
الفنون القتالية المختلطة

الإضافة رقمية فقط مع
نسخة Ultimate أو حزمتها
credits: العرض الأول من إلكترونيك آرتس (Electronic Arts)
headline:
بطولة PRIDE اليابانية
تدخل EA SPORTS UFC 6
label: رسمي
spoken: بطولة PRIDE اليابانية تدخل EA SPORTS UFC 6. كانت PRIDE من أشهر بطولات الفنون القتالية المختلطة. الإضافة رقمية فقط مع نسخة Ultimate أو حزمتها.

angle.hook: PRIDE, the Japanese MMA promotion, enters EA SPORTS UFC 6 as an expansion (EA SPORTS UFC on X, 15 Nov 02:02Z)
angle.why_now: announced with the official cover on 15 Nov 02:02Z; the full reveal premieres on YouTube Mon 16 Nov 11:00 ET = 20:00 Dubai, the evening of our slot
angle.what_it_means_here: UFC has a large Gulf following (Abu Dhabi events); UFC 6 owners on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S get it digitally on 11 Dec with the Ultimate Edition or the Ultimate add-on bundle; Gulf viewers can watch the reveal at 20:00 Dubai
angle.payoff: Max Holloway-style fighter posing centred in the cage under the closing line (illustration)

story_type_items.EVENT (reveal premiere): when: Mon 16 Nov 11:00 AM ET = 16:00Z = 20:00 Dubai (EA SPORTS UFC on X); where: YouTube premiere (caption)
story_type_items.OUT (dated add-on): date 11 Dec (EA SPORTS UFC on X); platforms: EA SPORTS UFC 6 is PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; price: none stated, the expansion comes with the Ultimate Edition or the Ultimate add-on bundle; what it is: a PRIDE-themed expansion, the first of the Ultimate Edition expansion pass (two expansions, Winter 2026 and Summer 2027, per EA's store listing via search)

decision_log: source: EA SPORTS UFC 6 official reveal trailer (EA, 5 May 2026), IGN MP4 2560x1440 (job URL); inspected on IGN's 1280 copy, same timeline. No PRIDE expansion footage exists before the 16 Nov 20:00 Dubai premiere (YouTube only); the cover art (X, 2160x2160 square) cannot be cropped to 9:16 without cutting the EA SPORTS, UFC 6 and PRIDE wordmarks at the edges, so the Reel uses the base game's trailer as illustration, credited «لقطات العرض الأول». Strikes, knockdowns and blood avoided: only walkouts, close-ups, celebrations, a hand-wrap check, a referee and a pose
beat hook 0-4.5 s (headline): 40.52 s walkout from behind into the cage (2.26 s), 43.98 s close-ups of two fighters then an arm raised to the crowd (2.25 s)

line 1 4.5-9.3 s 'كانت PRIDE من أشهر بطولات / الفنون القتالية المختلطة': 59.6 arena from above (1.0), 62.4 a glove-and-wrap check (0.45), 67.3 a fighter leaping on the walkout stage (0.95), 73.45 a fighter celebrating arms up then a close profile (2.4, ends 75.85 before the cut 'Paramount' text at 75.9); illustration of an MMA event

line 2 9.3-13.7 s 'الإضافة رقمية فقط مع / نسخة Ultimate أو حزمتها' (v1 line ran out of the safe zone in the server font check): 92.69 fighter face (0.85), 109.1 close face (0.9), 116.93 referee (0.95), 119.35 fighter posing centred (1.7, closing picture; prerender flagged smears at 119.13-119.33 and 121.07-121.45, both cut out)
strip: الإصدار 11 ديسمبر; العرض الكامل الليلة 8 مساءً (premiere 20:00 Dubai Mon); facts live in the strip only, the lines do not repeat them
